text:
If you’re chasing a bright fall day, give Saturday the nod: the gray start should give way to sunshine, with a high right around 57. A north breeze will make the waterfront feel sharper than the thermometer, especially early, with broad lake waters running 15 to 20 knots before easing, and waves around 1 to 2 feet. Tonight stays clear and chilly, with a low near 42.

Sunday is the warmer play, mostly sunny and reaching about 66, but a south wind builds, with 1 to 2 foot waves on the lake and stronger conditions developing later. The forecasters are confident about the cooler turn Monday, when showers and gusty winds arrive, followed by several cooler days. Take the long waterfront walk today, and if you’re boating Sunday, plan for a breezier ride and be off the broad lake before conditions build.
